prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want general guidance or specific shop recommendations in Pleasanton (names, addresses, phone numbers, review summaries)? If you want specifics I can look up current options for you.

If you want a quick answer now, here’s a practical approach so you get good tires and the best installation:

Where to buy (good options)
- Costco Tire Center — excellent prices on many popular passenger/SUV tires, free lifetime rotations/balance (for members), good mounting/balancing, and straightforward warranty handling. (Requires membership.)
- Discount Tire (aka America's Tire) — large selection, competitive pricing, reliable installs, often same-day appointments; technicians are experienced and they’re known for good customer service.
- Big-name chains (Firestone Complete Auto Care, Tire Pros, Pep Boys) — convenient, frequent promotions, and national warranty coverage.
- Local independent tire shops — often give more personal service, faster appointments, and can be better for specialty tires or custom wheel work. Quality varies, so pick one with strong local reviews and ASE-certified techs.
- Buy online (Tire Rack, SimpleTire, tirerack.com, etc.) + local installer — can save money but be sure the installer will accept shipped tires and will balance/align properly.

Who does the best installation (how to pick)
Rather than a single name, choose a shop that meets these criteria:
- ASE-certified technicians or equivalent credentials listed
- Positive recent reviews mentioning mounting, balancing, and alignment
- Uses computerized alignment racks and offers a post-installation alignment check (especially if changing sizes or worn suspension)
- Offers road-force or high-precision balancing if you’re getting higher-performance tires or you’ve had vibration issues
- Includes mounting, valve stems, proper torqueing, and a test drive/inspection in the price
- Provides written warranty information and clear policies on rotations, balancing, and returns
- Good communication about TPMS (relearn fees/TPMS sensors), recommended torque specs, and disposal fees

Questions to ask any shop before committing
- Is mounting, balancing, and valve stems included? Any extra fees?
- Do you offer road-force balancing (if I’ve had vibrations)?
- Is a wheel alignment included or available as an add-on? What’s the cost?
- Do you accept tires shipped to you? Any handling fee?
- What are the rotation and balance/warranty terms?
- Can you install today or when is the earliest appointment?

How to verify quality quickly
- Check Google and Yelp for recent reviews (look at recent install & vibration comments)
- Ask whether techs are ASE certified
- Inspect the job: wheels torqued, no damaged valve stems, tires seated evenly, TPMS functioning, and request a test drive with the installer present if you still feel vibration

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated tire shops and chains in Pleasanton with addresses, phone numbers, typical install wait times, and a quick summary of local reviews
- Recommend specific tires for your vehicle, driving style, and budget

Which would you like me to do next? If you want specific shops, tell me your vehicle (make/model/year) and whether you have a preference (Costco/member, same-day install, budget vs performance).
